name: What's the difference between cosmetic repair and full renovation for a foreclosed home?

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between cosmetic repair and full renovation for a foreclosed home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cosmetic repair focuses on surface-level improvements that enhance appearance without altering the structure or major systems. This includes painting, new flooring, light fixtures, and minor patching. A full renovation, conversely, involves more extensive work like reconfiguring layouts, upgrading electrical and plumbing systems, replacing kitchens and bathrooms, or even structural modifications. Full renovations address deeper issues and typically require more time and investment than cosmetic updates.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cosmetic repair updates appearance without structural changes, like painting or new flooring. Full renovation involves extensive work, such as system upgrades, layout changes, or structural modifications.
